title: Import and export
subtitle: Bring your companies and contacts from a CSV (Excel, Pipedrive, HubSpot, Holded…) and take them out whenever you want.

step1.title: 1. Choose what to import
step1.description: The file is read in your browser; nothing is written to the CRM until you press “Import”.
step1.onDuplicateHint: Companies: same tax ID or name. Contacts: same email.

file.label: CSV file
file.empty: The file is empty or not recognised as CSV.
file.tooMany: The file has too many rows (maximum {{max}}). Split it into several.

step2.title: 2. Match the columns
step2.description: We proposed a match; fix it if needed. Anything left as “Do not import” is ignored.
step2.needRequired: Match at least the name column.

simulation.description: This is what will happen when you import. Nothing has been written to your CRM yet.

problems.title: Rows with warnings or errors
problems.more: … and {{count}} more (download the CSV to see them all).

failed: The import was interrupted. You can reopen it from the history to resume it.

rollback.confirm: Undo the whole import? What it created will be removed and what it completed will be restored.
rollback.keptSome_one: Import undone; {{count}} record is kept because you already used it.
rollback.keptSome_other: Import undone; {{count}} records are kept because you already used them.

history.title: Import history
history.empty: You have not imported anything yet.

export.title: Export your data
export.description: Download all your companies or contacts as CSV (Excel compatible).
